data.prometheus.yml:
global:
  scrape_interval: 5s
  evaluation_interval: 5s
rule_files: [/etc/prometheus/rules.yml]
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: ticket-pods
    kubernetes_sd_configs:
      - role: pod
        namespaces: {names: [dev, stage]}
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app]
        action: keep
        regex: ticket-api
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_container_port_name]
        action: keep
        regex: http
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_namespace]
        target_label: namespace
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name]
        target_label: pod
data.rules.yml:
groups:
  - name: ticket-lab
    rules:
      - alert: TicketReadinessLost
        expr: sum by (namespace) (ticket_ready) == 0
        for: 30s
        labels: {severity: training}
        annotations:
          summary: All observed API instances have failed readiness
      - alert: TicketTargetsMissingStage
        expr: absent(up{job="ticket-pods",namespace="stage"})
        for: 30s
        labels: {severity: training}
        annotations:
          summary: No stage API scrape targets are observed
      - alert: TicketScrapeFailed
        expr: up{job="ticket-pods"} == 0
        for: 30s
        labels: {severity: training}
        annotations:
          summary: Metrics endpoint is not being scraped successfully
      - alert: TicketHigh5xx
        expr: (sum by (namespace) (rate(ticket_http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[1m])) / sum by (namespace) (rate(ticket_http_requests_total[1m])) > 0.05) and (sum by (namespace) (rate(ticket_http_requests_total[1m])) > 0)
        for: 30s
        labels: {severity: training}
        annotations:
          summary: Observed server HTTP errors exceed the training threshold

data.datasources.yaml:
apiVersion: 1
datasources:
  - name: Prometheus
    type: prometheus
    uid: dva-prom
    access: proxy
    url: http://prometheus:9090
    isDefault: true
data.dashboards.yaml:
apiVersion: 1
providers:
  - name: training
    type: file
    options:
      path: /var/lib/grafana/dashboards
